subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages into a later mentioned turn, and under what bounds?
rationale: The source fix is clear, but it changes a privacy/security boundary because media that did not mention the bot would be stored and later exposed to model context.

options.title: Approve bounded history media
options.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small, local-image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of unmentioned group media and replay it only after the same group/thread visibility checks pass.

options.title: Keep current privacy default
options.body: Continue skipping unaddressed group media before download and document that only text history is retained for later mentions.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add or reuse a per-group or per-topic policy before unmentioned group media can be retained for later model context.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded history media
recommendation.body: Allow Telegram to retain a small, local-image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of unmentioned group media and replay it only after the same group/thread visibility checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The current media skip was introduced in the Telegram gate that any fix would need to adjust.
